label: Create the built-in IPTV and VIP groups and place ungrouped IPTV / VIP packages in them

execute.description: the built-in groups exist (kept as they are when already there)
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."packageGroup" ("name", "nameEn", "slug", "sortOrder", "isActive", "accent", "surface", "delivery", "serviceType", "createdAt", "updatedAt") VALUES ('باقات IPTV', 'IPTV plans', 'iptv', 0, true, '#3d6bff', '#0b1738', 'ACCOUNT', 'IPTV', now(), now()), ('باقات VIP', 'VIP plans', 'vip', 1, true, '#f1cf7a', '#0b1738', 'ACCOUNT', 'VIP', now(), now()) ON CONFLICT ("slug") DO NOTHING

execute.description: only packages without a group join the group of their service type
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."package" p SET "groupId" = g."id" FROM "public"."packageGroup" g WHERE p."groupId" IS NULL AND g."slug" = lower(p."serviceType") AND upper(p."serviceType") IN ('IPTV', 'VIP')

postcheck.description: no IPTV or VIP package is left without a group
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."package" p WHERE p."groupId" IS NULL AND upper(p."serviceType") IN ('IPTV', 'VIP')) AS "result"
